segments.name: Toys/Consumer Products
segments.description: Designs, develops, markets and distributes action figures, vehicles, play sets, plush, dolls, role play toys and kids' furniture for children and retailers.
segments.evidence: The Toys/Consumer Products ("TCP") segment includes action figures, vehicles, play sets, plush products, dolls, electronic products, construction toys, infant and pre-school toys, child-sized and hand-held role play toys and everyday costume play, foot-to-floor ride-on vehicles, wagons, novelty toys, seasonal and outdoor products, kids' indoor and outdoor furniture, and related products.

segments.name: Costumes
products: every-day and special occasion dress-up costumes
segments.description: Designs and sells every-day and special occasion dress-up costumes and accessories under the Disguise brand for Halloween and costume play.
segments.evidence: The Costumes segment, under its Disguise branding, designs, develops, markets and sells a wide range of every-day and special occasion dress-up costumes and related accessories in support of Halloween, Carnival, Children's Day, Book Day/Week, and every-day/any-day costume play.

revenueModel.text: Retailers, wholesalers and distributors pay for toys, consumer products and costumes sold through our sales staff, e-commerce sites and third-party distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products through our in-house sales staff and independent sales representatives to toy and mass-market retail chain stores, department stores, office supply stores, drug and grocery store chains, club stores, value-oriented dollar stores, toy specialty stores and wholesalers.
